messages.subject: WC-00115 - Schedule of Loss for your review
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Lesley,

Please find attached our draft Schedule of Loss. It builds up to a total claim of £1,099,250: the £487,250 of unpaid invoices plus £612,000 net loss of profit on the unexpired term (after credit for the redeployed vehicles and the Halcyon replacement income).

Could you confirm the mitigation figures match your management accounts? In particular the Halcyon income credited from August.

Kind regards,
Elena

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0000 | www.whitfieldcarter.com
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.plaintextBody:
Elena,

Thanks,
